title: Prototype pollution

blocks.md:
## Do not merge untrusted keys onto Object.prototype

`obj.__proto__` or a merge of `{ "__proto__": { polluted: true } }` can change **every** object.

Safe dictionaries: `Object.create(null)` or `Object.assign` onto a new object **without** copying `__proto__`. `Object.freeze(Object.prototype)` is a belt.

`safeMerge(target, src)` copies only own keys that are not `__proto__` or `constructor`.

blocks.promptMd: > `safeMerge({}, { __proto__: { x: 1 }, name: "n" }).name` prints `n`. Hidden: prototype stays clean.

description: Do not let outside data write into the shared object behind every record.
